```css
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 1rem 0;
    min-height: 0;
}

/* Upload Zone */
.upload-zone {
    background: var(--instant-surface);
    border: 3px dashed var(--instant-border);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    padding: 3rem 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    transition: var(--instant-transition);
    max-width: 600px;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 2rem auto;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.upload-zone::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 30%, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1) 50%, transparent 70%);
    transform: translateX(-100%);
    transition: transform 0.6s ease;
}

.upload-zone:hover::before {
    transform: translateX(100%);
}

.upload-zone.drag-over {
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.05);
    transform: scale(1.02);
    box-shadow: var(--instant-shadow);
}

.upload-zone.drag-over .upload-icon {
    transform: scale(1.1);
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

.upload-content {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
}

.upload-icon {
    font-size: 4rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    transition: var(--instant-transition);
}

.upload-zone h2 {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-text);
}

.upload-subtitle {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.upload-info {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.info-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 50px;
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    transition: var(--instant-transition);
}

.info-item:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.info-item i {
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    font-size: 1.2rem;
}

.info-item span {
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 1rem;
}

/* Active States for Info Items */
.info-item.active {
    background: rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.2);
    border-color: rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.5);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.3);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.info-item.active i {
    color: #007bff;
}

.info-item.success {
    background: rgba(40, 167, 69, 0.2);
    border-color: rgba(40, 167, 69, 0.5);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(40, 167, 69, 0.3);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.info-item.success i {
    color: #28a745;
}

.info-item.error {
    background: rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.2);
    border-color: rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.5);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.3);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.info-item.error i {
    color: #dc3545;
}

/* Status Section */
.status-section {
    background: var(--instant-surface);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    padding: 2rem;
    margin-top: 2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    max-width: 600px;
    width: 100%;
}

/* Processing Interface */
.processing-container {
    text-align: center;
}

.processing-header {
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.processing-header i {
    font-size: 3rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.processing-header h3 {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    margin: 0;
}

.processing-progress {
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.processing-progress .progress-bar {
    width: 100%;
    height: 8px;
    background: var(--instant-border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.processing-progress .progress-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: var(--instant-primary);
    width: 0%;
    transition: width 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.processing-progress .progress-text {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.processing-steps {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    gap: 1rem;
}

.step {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 1rem;
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    border: 2px solid var(--instant-border);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    opacity: 0.5;
}

.step.pending {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-color: var(--instant-border);
}

.step.active {
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    opacity: 1;
}

.step i {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.step.active i {
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

.step span {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    text-align: center;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.step.active span {
    color: var(--instant-text);
}

.processing-actions {
    margin-top: 2rem;
}

.processing-actions .btn {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* Upload Preview */
.upload-preview {
    background: var(--instant-surface);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    padding: 3rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    margin: 2rem 0;
}

.preview-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    padding-bottom: 1rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
}

.upload-preview h3 {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--instant-text);
}

.upload-preview h3 i {
    margin-right: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

.btn-close {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.btn-close:hover {
    background: rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.1);
    color: #dc3545;
    transform: scale(1.1);
}

.preview-stats {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
    gap: 1.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
}

.stat-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.stat-item:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.stat-item.primary {
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.15);
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2);
}

.stat-item i {
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    font-size: 1.5rem;
}

.stat-item span {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.stat-item .primary-count {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

/* Secondary Types */
.secondary-types {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
}

.secondary-type {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    border-radius: 20px;
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    opacity: 0.6;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.secondary-type:hover {
    opacity: 0.8;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.secondary-type i {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
}

/* File Preview Showcase */
.file-preview-showcase {
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
}

.file-preview-showcase h4 {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    text-align: center;
}

.staggered-preview {
    position: relative;
    height: 400px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.staggered-item {
    position: absolute;
    transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.staggered-item:hover {
    transform: scale(1.05) rotate(0deg) !important;
    z-index: 1000 !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
}

.staggered-content {
    background: var(--instant-surface);
    border: 2px solid var(--instant-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 1rem;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    min-width: 200px;
    max-width: 250px;
}

.staggered-item:hover .staggered-content {
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2);
}

.staggered-image,
.staggered-video,
.staggered-icon {
    width: 100%;
    height: 150px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    position: relative;
}

.staggered-image img,
.staggered-video video {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
}

.staggered-icon {
    font-size: 3rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

.video-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    border-radius: 50%;
    width: 50px;
    height: 50px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.video-overlay i {
    color: white;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
}

.staggered-info {
    text-align: center;
}

.staggered-name {
    display: block;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.staggered-size {
    display: block;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 500;
}

/* Preview Actions */
.preview-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 2rem 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    margin-top: 2rem;
}

.preview-actions .btn {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    padding: 1rem 2rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
    min-width: 160px;
}

.preview-actions .btn-outline-primary {
    border-color: var(--instant-muted);
    color: var(--instant-muted);
}

.preview-actions .btn-outline-primary:hover {
    border-color: #dc3545;
    background-color: rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.1);
    color: #dc3545;
}

/* Escape key hint */
.preview-actions::after {
    content: 'Press ESC to cancel';
    display: block;
    text-align: center;
    margin-top: 1rem;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    opacity: 0.7;
}

.status-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
}

.status-icon {
    width: 50px;
    height: 50px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 12px;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    font-size: 1.5rem;
}

.status-text {
    flex: 1;
}

.status-title {
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    color: var(--instant-text);
}

.status-detail {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
}

/* Results Section */
.results-section {
    background: var(--instant-surface);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    padding: 2rem;
    margin-top: 2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    max-width: 800px;
    width: 100%;
}

.results-section h3 {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-success);
    text-align: center;
}

.results-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.result-card {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    transition: var(--instant-transition);
}

.result-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: var(--instant-shadow);
}

.result-card.success {
    border-color: var(--instant-success);
    background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.1);
}

.result-card.info {
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
}

.result-icon {
    width: 50px;
    height: 50px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    margin: 0 auto 1rem;
}

.result-card.success .result-icon {
    background: var(--instant-success);
    color: var(--instant-bg);
}

.result-card.info .result-icon {
    background: var(--instant-primary);
    color: var(--instant-bg);
}

.result-title {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
}

.result-value {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--instant-text);
}

.results-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

/* Buttons */
.btn {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    border-radius: 50px;
    padding: 0.75rem 2rem;
    transition: var(--instant-transition);
    border: 2px solid;
}

.btn-primary {
    background: var(--instant-primary);
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    color: var(--instant-bg);
}

.btn-primary:hover {
    background: transparent;
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.btn-outline-primary {
    background: transparent;
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

.btn-outline-primary:hover {
    background: var(--instant-primary);
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    color: var(--instant-bg);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* Footer */
.instant-footer {
    background: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    padding: 1rem 0;
    margin-top: auto;
}

.instant-footer p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .instant-header h1 {
        font-size: 2rem;
    }
    
    .upload-zone {
        padding: 2rem 1rem;
    }
    
    .upload-zone h2 {
        font-size: 2rem;
    }
    
    .upload-icon {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .upload-info {
        gap: 0.75rem;
    }
    
    .info-item {
        padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
    }
    
    .results-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
    
    .results-actions {
        flex-direction: column;
    }
}

/* Animations */
@keyframes slideIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(20px);
    }
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.status-section,
.results-section {
    animation: slideIn 0.5s ease-out;
}

@keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% {
        opacity: 1;
    }
    50% {
        opacity: 0.5;
    }
}

.upload-zone.drag-over .upload-icon {
    animation: pulse 1s infinite;
}

/* Progress Bar */
.upload-progress {
    margin: 2rem 0;
    padding: 1rem;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
}

.progress-bar {
    width: 100%;
    height: 8px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.progress-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--instant-primary), var(--instant-success));
    border-radius: 4px;
    transition: width 0.3s ease;
    width: 0%;
}

.progress-text {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    font-weight: 500;
}

/* File Status List */
.file-status-list {
    margin-top: 1rem;
    max-height: 200px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.file-status-item {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    transition: var(--instant-transition);
}

.file-status-item:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
}

.file-status-item.success {
    background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.1);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--instant-success);
}

.file-status-item.error {
    background: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-left: 3px solid #ff4444;
}

.file-name {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    flex: 1;
    margin-right: 1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.file-status {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: bold;
}

/* Loading Spinner */
.loading-spinner {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
    border-radius: 50%;
    border-top-color: var(--instant-primary);
    animation: spin 1s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes spin {
    to {
        transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
}

/* Terminator HUD Styles */
.terminator-hud {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    border: 2px solid var(--instant-primary);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    z-index: 10;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.95);
    transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    overflow: hidden;
}

.terminator-hud.active {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
}

/* HUD Corner Elements */
.hud-corner {
    position: absolute;
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    border: 2px solid var(--instant-primary);
}

.hud-top-left {
    top: 10px;
    left: 10px;
    border-right: none;
    border-bottom: none;
}

.hud-top-right {
    top: 10px;
    right: 10px;
    border-left: none;
    border-bottom: none;
}

.hud-bottom-left {
    bottom: 10px;
    left: 10px;
    border-right: none;
    border-top: none;
}

.hud-bottom-right {
    bottom: 10px;
    right: 10px;
    border-left: none;
    border-top: none;
}

/* HUD Content */
.hud-content {
    padding: 2rem;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
}

.hud-main {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2rem;
    height: 100%;
}

.hud-left {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

.hud-right {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.hud-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--instant-primary);
    padding-bottom: 1rem;
}

.hud-title {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--instant-primary);
}

.hud-status {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-success);
    font-weight: bold;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-success);
    border-radius: 4px;
    text-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--instant-success);
}

/* HUD Metrics Grid */
.hud-metrics {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.hud-metric {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.05);
}

.metric-label {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.metric-value {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--instant-primary);
}

/* HUD Progress */
.hud-progress {
    text-align: center;
}

.hud-progress .progress-bar {
    height: 6px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 3px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.hud-progress .progress-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--instant-primary), var(--instant-success));
    border-radius: 3px;
    transition: width 0.3s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--instant-primary);
}

.progress-text {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* HUD Animations */
@keyframes hudScan {
    0% {
        background-position: -100% 0;
    }
    100% {
        background-position: 200% 0;
    }
}

.terminator-hud::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--instant-primary), transparent);
    animation: hudScan 2s linear infinite;
}

/* Thumbnail Scanner */
.thumbnail-scanner {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-primary);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 1rem;
    height: 100%;
}

.scanner-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--instant-primary);
    padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.scanner-title {
    font-family: 'Orbitron', 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.scanline {
    width: 100%;
    height: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--instant-primary), transparent);
    animation: scanlineMove 2s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes scanlineMove {
    0% { transform: translateX(-100%); }
    100% { transform: translateX(100%); }
}

.thumbnail-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 0.75rem;
    max-height: 300px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.thumbnail-item {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.thumbnail-preview {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 80px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.thumbnail-preview img,
.thumbnail-preview video {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
}

.thumbnail-preview .file-icon {
    font-size: 2rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}

.thumbnail-preview .file-icon i {
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--instant-primary);
}

.scanline-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--instant-success), transparent);
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-100%);
}

.scanline-overlay.scanning {
    animation: scanlineScan 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes scanlineScan {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(-100%);
    }
    50% {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(50px);
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(100px);
    }
}

.thumbnail-info {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.thumbnail-info .file-name {
    font-family: 'Orbitron', 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex: 1;
    margin-right: 0.5rem;
}

.thumbnail-info .file-size {
    font-family: 'Orbitron', 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 0.625rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    font-weight: bold;
}

.file-insights {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.25rem;
}

.insight {
    font-family: 'Orbitron', 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 0.625rem;
    color: var(--instant-success);
    background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-success);
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 0.125rem 0.25rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* Responsive HUD */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .hud-main {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .hud-metrics {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .hud-content {
        padding: 1rem;
    }
    
    .hud-title {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
    
    .metric-value {
        font-size: 1.25rem;
    }
    
    .thumbnail-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

/* Two-Panel Layout */
.two-panel-layout {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 2rem auto;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 500px;
}

.left-panel {
    background: var(--instant-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    padding: 1.5rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.right-panel {
    background: var(--instant-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    padding: 1.5rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.panel-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    padding-bottom: 1rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
}

.panel-header h3 {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
}

.panel-header .btn-close {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    transition: var(--instant-transition);
}

.panel-header .btn-close:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    color: var(--instant-text);
}

.file-details {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.file-preview {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    border: 2px dashed var(--instant-border);
    min-height: 300px;
}

.panel-actions {
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
    padding-top: 1rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
}

.panel-actions .btn {
    flex: 1;
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* File Detail Items */
.file-detail-item {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0.75rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
}

.file-detail-item .file-info {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    flex: 1;
}

.file-detail-item .file-icon {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

.file-detail-item .file-name {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.file-detail-item .file-size {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    font-family: 'Orbitron', 'Courier New', monospace;
}

/* Preview Content */
.preview-content {
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
}

.preview-content img,
.preview-content video {
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 100%;
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    box-shadow: var(--instant-shadow);
}

.preview-placeholder {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
}

.preview-placeholder i {
    font-size: 3rem;
    opacity: 0.5;
}

/* Responsive Two-Panel */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .two-panel-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .left-panel,
    .right-panel {
        padding: 1rem;
    }
    
    .panel-header h3 {
        font-size: 1.25rem;
    }
    
    .file-preview {
        min-height: 200px;
    }
}

```

Now let me remove the hover effects from the info items since they're not interactive:

```css
/* Q10UX Instant Upload - Ultra Simple Styles */
:root {
    --instant-bg: #0a0a0a;
    --instant-surface: #1a1a1a;
    --instant-primary: #00d4ff;
    --instant-success: #00ff88;
    --instant-text: #ffffff;
    --instant-muted: #888888;
    --instant-border: #333333;
    --instant-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    --instant-radius: 16px;
    --instant-transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.instant-upload-container {
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--instant-bg) 0%, #1a1a2e 100%);
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

/* Header */
.instant-header {
    background: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    padding: 2rem 0;
    text-align: center;
}

.instant-header h1 {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

.instant-header h1 i {
    margin-right: 0.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

/* Main Content */
.instant-main {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 1rem 0;
    min-height: 0;
}

/* Upload Zone */
.upload-zone {
    background: var(--instant-surface);
    border: 3px dashed var(--instant-border);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    padding: 3rem 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    transition: var(--instant-transition);
    max-width: 600px;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 2rem auto;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.upload-zone::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 30%, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1) 50%, transparent 70%);
    transform: translateX(-100%);
    transition: transform 0.6s ease;
}

.upload-zone:hover::before {
    transform: translateX(100%);
}

.upload-zone.drag-over {
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.05);
    transform: scale(1.02);
    box-shadow: var(--instant-shadow);
}

.upload-zone.drag-over .upload-icon {
    transform: scale(1.1);
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

.upload-content {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
}

.upload-icon {
    font-size: 4rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    transition: var(--instant-transition);
}

.upload-zone h2 {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-text);
}

.upload-subtitle {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.upload-info {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.info-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 50px;
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    transition: var(--instant-transition);
}

/* Removed hover effects since info items are not interactive */

.info-item i {
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    font-size: 1.2rem;
}

.info-item span {
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 1rem;
}

/* Active States for Info Items */
.info-item.active {
    background: rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.2);
    border-color: rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.5);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.3);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.info-item.active i {
    color: #007bff;
}

.info-item.success {
    background: rgba(40, 167, 69, 0.2);
    border-color: rgba(40, 167, 69, 0.5);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(40, 167, 69, 0.3);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.info-item.success i {
    color: #28a745;
}

.info-item.error {
    background: rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.2);
    border-color: rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.5);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.3);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.info-item.error i {
    color: #dc3545;
}

/* Status Section */
.status-section {
    background: var(--instant-surface);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    padding: 2rem;
    margin-top: 2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    max-width: 600px;
    width: 100%;
}

/* Processing Interface */
.processing-container {
    text-align: center;
}

.processing-header {
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.processing-header i {
    font-size: 3rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.processing-header h3 {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    margin: 0;
}

.processing-progress {
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.processing-progress .progress-bar {
    width: 100%;
    height: 8px;
    background: var(--instant-border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.processing-progress .progress-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: var(--instant-primary);
    width: 0%;
    transition: width 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.processing-progress .progress-text {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.processing-steps {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    gap: 1rem;
}

.step {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 1rem;
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    border: 2px solid var(--instant-border);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    opacity: 0.5;
}

.step.pending {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-color: var(--instant-border);
}

.step.active {
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    opacity: 1;
}

.step i {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.step.active i {
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

.step span {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    text-align: center;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.step.active span {
    color: var(--instant-text);
}

.processing-actions {
    margin-top: 2rem;
}

.processing-actions .btn {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* Upload Preview */
.upload-preview {
    background: var(--instant-surface);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    padding: 3rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    margin: 2rem 0;
}

.preview-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    padding-bottom: 1rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
}

.upload-preview h3 {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--instant-text);
}

.upload-preview h3 i {
    margin-right: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

.btn-close {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.btn-close:hover {
    background: rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.1);
    color: #dc3545;
    transform: scale(1.1);
}

.preview-stats {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
    gap: 1.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
}

.stat-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.stat-item:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.stat-item.primary {
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.15);
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2);
}

.stat-item i {
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    font-size: 1.5rem;
}

.stat-item span {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.stat-item .primary-count {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

/* Secondary Types */
.secondary-types {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
}

.secondary-type {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    border-radius: 20px;
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    opacity: 0.6;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.secondary-type:hover {
    opacity: 0.8;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.secondary-type i {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
}

/* File Preview Showcase */
.file-preview-showcase {
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
}

.file-preview-showcase h4 {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    text-align: center;
}

.staggered-preview {
    position: relative;
    height: 400px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.staggered-item {
    position: absolute;
    transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.staggered-item:hover {
    transform: scale(1.05) rotate(0deg) !important;
    z-index: 1000 !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
}

.staggered-content {
    background: var(--instant-surface);
    border: 2px solid var(--instant-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 1rem;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    min-width: 200px;
    max-width: 250px;
}

.staggered-item:hover .staggered-content {
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2);
}

.staggered-image,
.staggered-video,
.staggered-icon {
    width: 100%;
    height: 150px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    position: relative;
}

.staggered-image img,
.staggered-video video {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
}

.staggered-icon {
    font-size: 3rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

.video-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    border-radius: 50%;
    width: 50px;
    height: 50px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.video-overlay i {
    color: white;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
}

.staggered-info {
    text-align: center;
}

.staggered-name {
    display: block;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.staggered-size {
    display: block;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 500;
}

/* Preview Actions */
.preview-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 2rem 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    margin-top: 2rem;
}

.preview-actions .btn {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    padding: 1rem 2rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
    min-width: 160px;
}

.preview-actions .btn-outline-primary {
    border-color: var(--instant-muted);
    color: var(--instant-muted);
}

.preview-actions .btn-outline-primary:hover {
    border-color: #dc3545;
    background-color: rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.1);
    color: #dc3545;
}

/* Escape key hint */
.preview-actions::after {
    content: 'Press ESC to cancel';
    display: block;
    text-align: center;
    margin-top: 1rem;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    opacity: 0.7;
}

.status-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
}

.status-icon {
    width: 50px;
    height: 50px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 12px;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    font-size: 1.5rem;
}

.status-text {
    flex: 1;
}

.status-title {
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    color: var(--instant-text);
}

.status-detail {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
}

/* Results Section */
.results-section {
    background: var(--instant-surface);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    padding: 2rem;
    margin-top: 2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    max-width: 800px;
    width: 100%;
}

.results-section h3 {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-success);
    text-align: center;
}

.results-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.result-card {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    transition: var(--instant-transition);
}

.result-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: var(--instant-shadow);
}

.result-card.success {
    border-color: var(--instant-success);
    background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.1);
}

.result-card.info {
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
}

.result-icon {
    width: 50px;
    height: 50px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    margin: 0 auto 1rem;
}

.result-card.success .result-icon {
    background: var(--instant-success);
    color: var(--instant-bg);
}

.result-card.info .result-icon {
    background: var(--instant-primary);
    color: var(--instant-bg);
}

.result-title {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
}

.result-value {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--instant-text);
}

.results-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

/* Buttons */
.btn {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    border-radius: 50px;
    padding: 0.75rem 2rem;
    transition: var(--instant-transition);
    border: 2px solid;
}

.btn-primary {
    background: var(--instant-primary);
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    color: var(--instant-bg);
}

.btn-primary:hover {
    background: transparent;
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.btn-outline-primary {
    background: transparent;
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

.btn-outline-primary:hover {
    background: var(--instant-primary);
    border-color: var(--instant-primary);
    color: var(--instant-bg);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* Footer */
.instant-footer {
    background: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    padding: 1rem 0;
    margin-top: auto;
}

.instant-footer p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .instant-header h1 {
        font-size: 2rem;
    }
    
    .upload-zone {
        padding: 2rem 1rem;
    }
    
    .upload-zone h2 {
        font-size: 2rem;
    }
    
    .upload-icon {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .upload-info {
        gap: 0.75rem;
    }
    
    .info-item {
        padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
    }
    
    .results-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
    
    .results-actions {
        flex-direction: column;
    }
}

/* Animations */
@keyframes slideIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(20px);
    }
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.status-section,
.results-section {
    animation: slideIn 0.5s ease-out;
}

@keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% {
        opacity: 1;
    }
    50% {
        opacity: 0.5;
    }
}

.upload-zone.drag-over .upload-icon {
    animation: pulse 1s infinite;
}

/* Progress Bar */
.upload-progress {
    margin: 2rem 0;
    padding: 1rem;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
}

.progress-bar {
    width: 100%;
    height: 8px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.progress-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--instant-primary), var(--instant-success));
    border-radius: 4px;
    transition: width 0.3s ease;
    width: 0%;
}

.progress-text {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    font-weight: 500;
}

/* File Status List */
.file-status-list {
    margin-top: 1rem;
    max-height: 200px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.file-status-item {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    transition: var(--instant-transition);
}

.file-status-item:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
}

.file-status-item.success {
    background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.1);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--instant-success);
}

.file-status-item.error {
    background: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-left: 3px solid #ff4444;
}

.file-name {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    flex: 1;
    margin-right: 1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.file-status {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: bold;
}

/* Loading Spinner */
.loading-spinner {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
    border-radius: 50%;
    border-top-color: var(--instant-primary);
    animation: spin 1s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes spin {
    to {
        transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
}

/* Terminator HUD Styles */
.terminator-hud {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    border: 2px solid var(--instant-primary);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    z-index: 10;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.95);
    transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    overflow: hidden;
}

.terminator-hud.active {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
}

/* HUD Corner Elements */
.hud-corner {
    position: absolute;
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    border: 2px solid var(--instant-primary);
}

.hud-top-left {
    top: 10px;
    left: 10px;
    border-right: none;
    border-bottom: none;
}

.hud-top-right {
    top: 10px;
    right: 10px;
    border-left: none;
    border-bottom: none;
}

.hud-bottom-left {
    bottom: 10px;
    left: 10px;
    border-right: none;
    border-top: none;
}

.hud-bottom-right {
    bottom: 10px;
    right: 10px;
    border-left: none;
    border-top: none;
}

/* HUD Content */
.hud-content {
    padding: 2rem;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
}

.hud-main {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2rem;
    height: 100%;
}

.hud-left {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

.hud-right {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.hud-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--instant-primary);
    padding-bottom: 1rem;
}

.hud-title {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--instant-primary);
}

.hud-status {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-success);
    font-weight: bold;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-success);
    border-radius: 4px;
    text-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--instant-success);
}

/* HUD Metrics Grid */
.hud-metrics {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.hud-metric {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.05);
}

.metric-label {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.metric-value {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--instant-primary);
}

/* HUD Progress */
.hud-progress {
    text-align: center;
}

.hud-progress .progress-bar {
    height: 6px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 3px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.hud-progress .progress-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--instant-primary), var(--instant-success));
    border-radius: 3px;
    transition: width 0.3s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--instant-primary);
}

.progress-text {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* HUD Animations */
@keyframes hudScan {
    0% {
        background-position: -100% 0;
    }
    100% {
        background-position: 200% 0;
    }
}

.terminator-hud::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--instant-primary), transparent);
    animation: hudScan 2s linear infinite;
}

/* Thumbnail Scanner */
.thumbnail-scanner {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-primary);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 1rem;
    height: 100%;
}

.scanner-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--instant-primary);
    padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.scanner-title {
    font-family: 'Orbitron', 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.scanline {
    width: 100%;
    height: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--instant-primary), transparent);
    animation: scanlineMove 2s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes scanlineMove {
    0% { transform: translateX(-100%); }
    100% { transform: translateX(100%); }
}

.thumbnail-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 0.75rem;
    max-height: 300px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.thumbnail-item {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.thumbnail-preview {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 80px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.thumbnail-preview img,
.thumbnail-preview video {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
}

.thumbnail-preview .file-icon {
    font-size: 2rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}

.thumbnail-preview .file-icon i {
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
    text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--instant-primary);
}

.scanline-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--instant-success), transparent);
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-100%);
}

.scanline-overlay.scanning {
    animation: scanlineScan 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes scanlineScan {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(-100%);
    }
    50% {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(50px);
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(100px);
    }
}

.thumbnail-info {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.thumbnail-info .file-name {
    font-family: 'Orbitron', 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex: 1;
    margin-right: 0.5rem;
}

.thumbnail-info .file-size {
    font-family: 'Orbitron', 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 0.625rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    font-weight: bold;
}

.file-insights {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.25rem;
}

.insight {
    font-family: 'Orbitron', 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 0.625rem;
    color: var(--instant-success);
    background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-success);
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 0.125rem 0.25rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* Responsive HUD */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .hud-main {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .hud-metrics {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .hud-content {
        padding: 1rem;
    }
    
    .hud-title {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
    
    .metric-value {
        font-size: 1.25rem;
    }
    
    .thumbnail-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

/* Two-Panel Layout */
.two-panel-layout {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 2rem auto;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 500px;
}

.left-panel {
    background: var(--instant-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    padding: 1.5rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.right-panel {
    background: var(--instant-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    padding: 1.5rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.panel-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    padding-bottom: 1rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
}

.panel-header h3 {
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
}

.panel-header .btn-close {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    transition: var(--instant-transition);
}

.panel-header .btn-close:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    color: var(--instant-text);
}

.file-details {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.file-preview {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    border: 2px dashed var(--instant-border);
    min-height: 300px;
}

.panel-actions {
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
    padding-top: 1rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
}

.panel-actions .btn {
    flex: 1;
    font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* File Detail Items */
.file-detail-item {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0.75rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    border: 1px solid var(--instant-border);
}

.file-detail-item .file-info {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    flex: 1;
}

.file-detail-item .file-icon {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--instant-primary);
}

.file-detail-item .file-name {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--instant-text);
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.file-detail-item .file-size {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
    font-family: 'Orbitron', 'Courier New', monospace;
}

/* Preview Content */
.preview-content {
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
}

.preview-content img,
.preview-content video {
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 100%;
    border-radius: var(--instant-radius);
    box-shadow: var(--instant-shadow);
}

.preview-placeholder {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    color: var(--instant-muted);
}

.preview-placeholder i {
    font-size: 3rem;
    opacity: 0.5;
}

/* Responsive Two-Panel */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .two-panel-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .left-panel,
    .right-panel {
        padding: 1rem;
    }
    
    .panel-header h3 {
        font-size: 1.25rem;
    }
    
    .file-preview {
        min-height: 200px;
    }
}

```
