                <label class="form-label">Flow Type</label>
                <select class="form-select" id="bulkFileFlow">
                    <option value="">Select flow type...</option>
                    <option value="research">Research & Discovery</option>
                    <option value="ideation">Ideation & Brainstorming</option>
                    <option value="visual-design">Visual Design</option>
                    <option value="testing">Testing & Validation</option>
                    <option value="implementation">Implementation & Handoff</option>
                    <option value="results">Results & Impact</option>
                    <option value="screens">Final Screenshots</option>
                    <option value="process">Process Documentation</option>
                </select>
            </div>
            <div class="mb-3">
                <label class="form-label">Add Tags</label>
                <input type="text" class="form-control" id="bulkFileAddTags" placeholder="Enter tags separated by commas">
            </div>
        `;
    }

    createBulkFileMoveForm(fileIds) {
        const projectOptions = this.projects.map(project => 
            `<option value="${project.id}">${project.title}</option>`
        ).join('');
        
        return `
            <div class="mb-3">
                <label class="form-label">Move to Project</label>
                <select class="form-select" id="bulkFileMoveProject">
                    <option value="">Select project...</option>
                    ${projectOptions}
                </select>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    // Save Methods
    async saveBulkEdit(projectIds) {
        const status = document.getElementById('bulkStatus').value;
        const ndaRequired = document.getElementById('bulkNdaRequired').value;
        const addTags = document.getElementById('bulkAddTags').value;
        const removeTags = document.getElementById('bulkRemoveTags').value;

        try {
            for (const projectId of projectIds) {
                const project = this.getProjectById(projectId);
                if (project) {
                    if (status) project.status = status;
                    if (ndaRequired !== '') project.ndaRequired = ndaRequired === 'true';
                    if (addTags) {
                        const tagsToAdd = addTags.split(',').map(tag => tag.trim());
                        project.tags = [...(project.tags || []), ...tagsToAdd];
                    }
                    if (removeTags) {
                        const tagsToRemove = removeTags.split(',').map(tag => tag.trim());
                        project.tags = (project.tags || []).filter(tag => !tagsToRemove.includes(tag));
                    }
                }
            }

            this.renderProjects(this.projects);
            this.showNotification('Bulk edit completed successfully', 'success');
            bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.querySelector('.modal')).hide();
            
        } catch (error) {
            this.showNotification('Failed to save bulk edit', 'error');
            console.error('Bulk edit error:', error);
        }
    }

    async saveBulkTags(projectIds) {
        const addTags = document.getElementById('bulkAddTags').value;
        const removeTags = document.getElementById('bulkRemoveTags').value;

        try {
            for (const projectId of projectIds) {
                const project = this.getProjectById(projectId);
                if (project) {
                    if (addTags) {
                        const tagsToAdd = addTags.split(',').map(tag => tag.trim());
                        project.tags = [...(project.tags || []), ...tagsToAdd];
                    }
                    if (removeTags) {
                        const tagsToRemove = removeTags.split(',').map(tag => tag.trim());
                        project.tags = (project.tags || []).filter(tag => !tagsToRemove.includes(tag));
                    }
                }
            }

            this.renderProjects(this.projects);
            this.showNotification('Bulk tagging completed successfully', 'success');
            bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.querySelector('.modal')).hide();
            
        } catch (error) {
            this.showNotification('Failed to save bulk tags', 'error');
            console.error('Bulk tag error:', error);
        }
    }

    async saveBulkFileTags(fileIds) {
        const flowType = document.getElementById('bulkFileFlow').value;
        const addTags = document.getElementById('bulkFileAddTags').value;

        try {
            for (const fileId of fileIds) {
                const file = this.getFileById(fileId);
                if (file) {
                    if (flowType) file.flowType = flowType;
                    if (addTags) {
                        const tagsToAdd = addTags.split(',').map(tag => tag.trim());
                        file.tags = [...(file.tags || []), ...tagsToAdd];
                    }
                }
            }

            this.renderFiles(this.files);
            this.showNotification('Bulk file tagging completed successfully', 'success');
            bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.querySelector('.modal')).hide();
            
        } catch (error) {
            this.showNotification('Failed to save bulk file tags', 'error');
            console.error('Bulk file tag error:', error);
        }
    }

    async saveBulkFileMove(fileIds) {
        const targetProjectId = document.getElementById('bulkFileMoveProject').value;

        if (!targetProjectId) {
            this.showNotification('Please select a target project', 'warning');
            return;
        }

        try {
            for (const fileId of fileIds) {
                const file = this.getFileById(fileId);
                if (file) {
                    file.projectId = targetProjectId;
                }
            }

            this.renderFiles(this.files);
            this.showNotification('Files moved successfully', 'success');
            bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.querySelector('.modal')).hide();
            
        } catch (error) {
            this.showNotification('Failed to move files', 'error');
            console.error('Bulk file move error:', error);
        }
    }

    // Utility Methods
    getProjectById(projectId) {
        return this.projects.find(project => project.id === projectId);
    }

    getFileById(fileId) {
        return this.files.find(file => file.id === fileId);
    }

/* Notifications */
.notification {
    position: fixed;
    top: 20px;
    right: 20px;
    padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: white;
    font-weight: 600;
    z-index: 9999;
    transform: translateX(100%);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease-in-out;
    max-width: 400px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

.notification.show {
    transform: translateX(0);
}

.notification.success {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #28a745 0%, #20c997 100%);
    border-left: 6px solid #155724;
    border-color: #155724;
    color: #ffffff;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.notification.error {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #dc3545 0%, #c82333 100%);
    border-left: 6px solid #721c24;
    border-color: #721c24;
    color: #ffffff;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.notification.info {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #17a2b8 0%, #138496 100%);
    border-left: 6px solid #0c5460;
    border-color: #0c5460;
    color: #ffffff;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.notification.warning {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffc107 0%, #e0a800 100%);
    border-left: 6px solid #856404;
    border-color: #856404;
    color: #212529;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
}

/* High contrast mode support */
@media (prefers-contrast: high) {
    .notification {
        border-width: 3px;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    }
    
    .notification.success {
        background: #155724;
        border-color: #ffffff;
    }
    
    .notification.error {
        background: #721c24;
        border-color: #ffffff;
    }
    
    .notification.info {
        background: #0c5460;
        border-color: #ffffff;
    }
    
    .notification.warning {
        background: #856404;
        border-color: #ffffff;
        color: #ffffff;
    }
}

/* Reduced motion support */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .notification {
        transition: none;
    }
}

/* High contrast mode support */
@media (prefers-contrast: high) {
    .notification {
        border-width: 3px;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);

        background: #856404;
        border-color: #ffffff;
        color: #ffffff;
    }
}

/* Reduced motion support */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .notification {
        animation: none;
    }
    
    @keyframes slideIn {
        from {
            transform: translateX(100%);
            opacity: 0;
        }
        to {
            transform: translateX(0);
            opacity: 1;
        }
    }
}

                badge.textContent = this.getFlowDisplayName(newFlow);
            }
            
            this.showNotification(`Flow assignment updated for ${filename}`, 'success');

    }

    togglePriority(projectId) {
        // Toggle priority for a project
        const star = event.target;
        star.classList.toggle('active');
        
        if (star.classList.contains('active')) {
            this.showNotification('Project marked as high priority', 'info');
        } else {
            this.showNotification('Project priority removed', 'info');
        }
    }

    togglePriority(projectId) {

        const star = event.target;

->

    togglePriority(projectId) {
        // Toggle priority for a project
        const star = event.target;
        star.classList.toggle('active');
        
        if (star.classList.contains('active')) {
            this.showNotification('Project marked as high priority', 'info');
        } else {
            this.showNotification('Project priority removed', 'info');
        }
    }

    initializeResizableColumns() {
        const resizeHandles = document.querySelectorAll('.resize-handle');
        
        resizeHandles.forEach(handle => {
            handle.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                this.startResize(e, handle);
            });
        });
    }

    startResize(e, handle) {
        const column = handle.parentElement;
        const columnType = handle.dataset.column;
        const startX = e.clientX;
        const startWidth = column.offsetWidth;
        
        handle.classList.add('resizing');
        
        const doResize = (e) => {
            const deltaX = e.clientX - startX;
            const newWidth = Math.max(50, startWidth + deltaX); // Minimum 50px width
            
            // Update the column width
            column.style.width = `${newWidth}px`;
            
            // Update all similar columns in the list
            const allColumns = document.querySelectorAll(`.list-column-${columnType}`);
            allColumns.forEach(col => {
                col.style.width = `${newWidth}px`;
            });
        };
        
        const stopResize = () => {
            handle.classList.remove('resizing');
            document.removeEventListener('mousemove', doResize);
            document.removeEventListener('mouseup', stopResize);
            
            // Save the column width to localStorage
            localStorage.setItem(`column-width-${columnType}`, column.style.width);
        };
        
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', doResize);
        document.addEventListener('mouseup', stopResize);
    }

    loadColumnWidths() {
        const columnTypes = ['checkbox', 'priority', 'title', 'status', 'date', 'size', 'actions'];
        
        columnTypes.forEach(type => {
            const savedWidth = localStorage.getItem(`column-width-${type}`);
            if (savedWidth) {
                const columns = document.querySelectorAll(`.list-column-${type}`);
                columns.forEach(col => {
                    col.style.width = savedWidth;
                });
            }
        });
    }

## 🎯 **Resizable Columns with Drag Handles**

### **Key Features:**

1. **Visual Resize Handles:**
   - Thin blue handles between columns that appear on hover
   - Clear visual feedback when dragging
   - Positioned on the right edge of each column

2. **Flexible Layout:**
   - Changed from CSS Grid to Flexbox for better control
   - Each column has defined widths with `min-width` constraints
   - Title column uses `flex: 1` to take remaining space

3. **Interactive Resizing:**
   - Click and drag handles to resize columns
   - Real-time width updates during drag
   - Minimum 50px width to prevent columns from disappearing
   - All similar columns update simultaneously

4. **Persistent Settings:**
   - Column widths saved to localStorage
   - Widths restored when page reloads
   - Individual settings per column type

5. **Enhanced Header:**
   - Sticky header with column titles
   - Same resize handles in header
   - Professional table-like appearance

### **Column Structure:**
- **Checkbox**: 50px (fixed)
- **Priority**: 80px (resizable)
- **Title**: Flexible (resizable, takes remaining space)
- **Status**: 120px (resizable)
- **Created**: 100px (resizable)
- **Size**: 80px (resizable)
- **Actions**: 120px (resizable)

### **How to Use:**
- **Hover** over column edges to see resize handles
- **Click and drag** handles to resize columns
- **Settings persist** across page reloads
- **Title column** automatically adjusts to fill remaining space

This gives you full control over column widths while maintaining a clean, professional interface! 🚀

```javascript
    updateBulkActions() {
        const selectedCount = this.selectedProjects.size;
        const bulkInfo = document.getElementById('bulkInfo');
        const bulkButtons = document.querySelectorAll('#bulkActions .btn');
        const selectAllCheckbox = document.getElementById('selectAll');
        
        if (bulkInfo) {
            bulkInfo.textContent = `${selectedCount} selected`;
        }
        
        // Enable/disable bulk action buttons
        bulkButtons.forEach(btn => {
            btn.disabled = selectedCount === 0;
        });
        
        // Update select all checkbox state
        if (selectAllCheckbox) {
            selectAllCheckbox.checked = selectedCount === this.projects.length && this.projects.length > 0;
            selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = selectedCount > 0 && selectedCount < this.projects.length;
        }
    }

->

    updateBulkActions() {
        const selectedCount = this.selectedProjects.size;
        const bulkInfo = document.getElementById('bulkInfo');
        const bulkButtons = document.querySelectorAll('#bulkActions .btn');
        const selectAllCheckbox = document.getElementById('selectAll');
        
        if (bulkInfo) {
            bulkInfo.textContent = `${selectedCount} selected`;
        }
        
        // Enable/disable bulk action buttons
        bulkButtons.forEach(btn => {
            btn.disabled = selectedCount === 0;
        });
        
        // Update select all checkbox state
        if (selectAllCheckbox) {
            selectAllCheckbox.checked = selectedCount === this.projects.length && this.projects.length > 0;
            selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = selectedCount > 0 && selectedCount < this.projects.length;
        }
    }

    // Bulk CRUD Operations
    bulkEdit() {
        const selectedIds = Array.from(this.selectedProjects);
        if (selectedIds.length === 0) return;
        
        if (selectedIds.length === 1) {
            // Single item - go directly to edit mode
            this.viewProject(selectedIds[0]);
            this.showNotification('Edit mode activated for selected project', 'info');
        } else {
            // Multiple items - show bulk edit modal
            this.showBulkEditModal(selectedIds);
        }
    }

    bulkDuplicate() {
        const selectedIds = Array.from(this.selectedProjects);
        if (selectedIds.length === 0) return;
        
        if (confirm(`Duplicate ${selectedIds.length} case study${selectedIds.length > 1 ? 'ies' : ''}?`)) {
            selectedIds.forEach(id => {
                this.duplicateProject(id);
            });
            this.showNotification(`${selectedIds.length} case study${selectedIds.length > 1 ? 'ies' : ''} duplicated successfully`, 'success');
            this.selectedProjects.clear();
            this.updateBulkActions();
            this.loadProjects(); // Refresh the list
        }
    }

    bulkArchive() {
        const selectedIds = Array.from(this.selectedProjects);
        if (selectedIds.length === 0) return;
        
        const action = confirm(`Archive ${selectedIds.length} case study${selectedIds.length > 1 ? 'ies' : ''}?`) ? 'archive' : 
                      confirm(`Unarchive ${selectedIds.length} case study${selectedIds.length > 1 ? 'ies' : ''}?`) ? 'unarchive' : null;
        
        if (action) {
            selectedIds.forEach(id => {
                this.toggleArchiveStatus(id, action === 'archive');
            });
            this.showNotification(`${selectedIds.length} case study${selectedIds.length > 1 ? 'ies' : ''} ${action}d successfully`, 'success');
            this.selectedProjects.clear();
            this.updateBulkActions();
            this.loadProjects(); // Refresh the list
        }
    }

    bulkTag() {
        const selectedIds = Array.from(this.selectedProjects);
        if (selectedIds.length === 0) return;
        
        this.showBulkTagModal(selectedIds);
    }

    bulkDelete() {
        const selectedIds = Array.from(this.selectedProjects);
        if (selectedIds.length === 0) return;
        
        if (confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete ${selectedIds.length} case study${selectedIds.length > 1 ? 'ies' : ''}? This action cannot be undone.`)) {
            selectedIds.forEach(id => {
                this.deleteProject(id);
            });
            this.showNotification(`${selectedIds.length} case study${selectedIds.length > 1 ? 'ies' : ''} deleted successfully`, 'success');
            this.selectedProjects.clear();
            this.updateBulkActions();
            this.loadProjects(); // Refresh the list
        }
    }

    // Individual CRUD Operations
    duplicateProject(projectId) {
        const project = this.getProjectById(projectId);
        if (!project) return;
        
        const duplicatedProject = {
            ...project,
            id: `${project.id}-copy-${Date.now()}`,
            title: `${project.title} (Copy)`,
            status: 'draft',
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            slug: `${project.slug}-copy`
        };
        
        // Add to projects array
        this.projects.push(duplicatedProject);
        
        // Save to backend if available
        this.saveProjectToBackend(duplicatedProject);
    }

    toggleArchiveStatus(projectId, archive = true) {
        const project = this.getProjectById(projectId);
        if (!project) return;
        
        project.archived = archive;
        project.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        
        // Update backend if available
        this.updateProjectInBackend(project);
    }

    deleteProject(projectId) {
        const projectIndex = this.projects.findIndex(p => p.id === projectId);
        if (projectIndex === -1) return;
        
        // Remove from projects array
        this.projects.splice(projectIndex, 1);
        
        // Delete from backend if available
        this.deleteProjectFromBackend(projectId);
    }

    // Backend operations (with fallbacks)
    async saveProjectToBackend(project) {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${this.apiBase}/admin/projects`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'Authorization': `Bearer ${this.token}`
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(project)
            });
            
            if (!response.ok) {
                console.log('Backend save failed, using local storage');
                this.saveToLocalStorage();
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.log('Backend unavailable, using local storage');
            this.saveToLocalStorage();
        }
    }

    async updateProjectInBackend(project) {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${this.apiBase}/admin/projects/${project.id}`, {
                method: 'PUT',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'Authorization': `Bearer ${this.token}`
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(project)
            });
            
            if (!response.ok) {
                console.log('Backend update failed, using local storage');
                this.saveToLocalStorage();
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.log('Backend unavailable, using local storage');
            this.saveToLocalStorage();
        }
    }

    async deleteProjectFromBackend(projectId) {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${this.apiBase}/admin/projects/${projectId}`, {
                method: 'DELETE',
                headers: {
                    'Authorization': `Bearer ${this.token}`
                }
            });
            
            if (!response.ok) {
                console.log('Backend delete failed, using local storage');
                this.saveToLocalStorage();
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.log('Backend unavailable, using local storage');
            this.saveToLocalStorage();
        }
    }

    saveToLocalStorage() {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem('q10ux-projects', JSON.stringify(this.projects));
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to save to localStorage:', error);
        }
    }

    loadFromLocalStorage() {
        try {
            const saved = localStorage.getItem('q10ux-projects');
            if (saved) {
                this.projects = JSON.parse(saved);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to load from localStorage:', error);
        }
    }
```

/* View Containers */
.view-container {
    display: none;
    animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-in-out;
}

.view-container.active {
    display: block;
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* Grid View */
.projects-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
    gap: 1.5rem;
    padding: 1rem 0;
}

.project-card {
    background: var(--admin-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
}

.project-card:hover {
    border-color: var(--admin-primary);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.project-card h4 {
    margin: 0 0 0.75rem 0;
    color: var(--admin-text);
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.project-card p {
    color: var(--admin-muted);
    margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.project-meta {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--admin-muted);
}

.project-status {
    padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.project-status.draft {
    background: rgba(255, 170, 0, 0.2);
    color: var(--admin-warning);
}

.project-status.published {
    background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.2);
    color: var(--admin-success);
}

/* Gallery View */
.projects-gallery {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr));
    gap: 1.5rem;
    padding: 1rem 0;
}

.gallery-item {
    background: var(--admin-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.gallery-item:hover {
    border-color: var(--admin-primary);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.gallery-item-image {
    height: 150px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--admin-primary) 0%, var(--admin-secondary) 100%);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: white;
    font-size: 2rem;
}

.gallery-item-content {
    padding: 1rem;
}

.gallery-item-content h5 {
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;
    color: var(--admin-text);
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 1rem;
}

.gallery-item-content p {
    color: var(--admin-muted);
    margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.gallery-item-meta {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    align-items: center;
}

/* Cover View (iTunes-style) */
.projects-covers {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
    gap: 2rem;
    padding: 1rem 0;
}

.cover-item {
    text-align: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.cover-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
}

.cover-art {
    width: 150px;
    height: 150px;
    margin: 0 auto 1rem;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--admin-primary) 0%, var(--admin-secondary) 100%);
    border-radius: 12px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: white;
    font-size: 3rem;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.cover-item:hover .cover-art {
    box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    transform: scale(1.05);
}

.cover-info h5 {
    margin: 0 0 0.25rem 0;
    color: var(--admin-text);
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.cover-info p {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--admin-muted);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    line-height: 1.3;
}
